user.title: HFeasy plug
user.description: Local HTTP control of a plug running the HFeasy firmware.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the plug.
data_description.port: HTTP port of the plug (8080 by default).
data_description.username: Leave empty if the plug's web page is not password protected.

reauth_confirm.title: Plug credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The plug at {host} rejected the credentials. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the plug, or it does not answer like an HFeasy plug.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the plug state is read (5 to 3600 s).
